To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a methodology for extracting attributevalue pairs from semi-structured text that can be massively parallelized and that achieves 70% accuracy.

(1) the candidate generation phase of attribute-value extraction is well suited to parallelization, and can be made to run in a few hours on a large cluster; (2) the candidate filtering phase is not amenable to parallelization, but can be made to achieve high accuracy with careful tuning; and (3) the overall system can achieve high accuracy with reasonable effort.
We have developed a scalable, massively parallelizable methodology for extracting attribute-values from semi-structured web pages.

the design and implementation of a scalable system for attribute-value pair extraction from web pages.
the problem of extracting attribute-value pairs (AVP) from semi-structured web pages.

the problem of attribute-value extraction is not intractable for the web, and can be solved in a reasonable amount of time with a modest amount of computational power.
